name: type5-to-geojson-no-geometry
source: gpsd test/sample.aivdm (BSD-2-Clause), sentences at lines 124 and 125
reference: Type 5: no position, so geometry is null (ruling 5 of 0.1.1); the call sign is the only shared key. geojson writes coordinates [lon, lat], properties in field-line order (callsign, course, speed_ms), then id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); uid is derived as text_of(ais.mmsi) (model/ais.def), so it is checked with @complete.
